movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Active arm movements used to strike the thirteen manjiras attached to body parts.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two or three women seated on the ground.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled, steady torso movements maintaining balance while seated.
movement_profile.partnering: Group synchronization among two or three seated dancers.
movement_profile.posture: Seated on the ground with upright spine to support head balancing.

signature_moves.description: Rhythmically striking thirteen body-tied metal cymbals while seated.
signature_moves.name: Manjira Striking

signature_moves.description: Balancing an ornamental pot on the head covered with a hat or petha.
signature_moves.name: Head Balancing

signature_moves.description: Holding a small sword clenched firmly between the teeth while dancing.
signature_moves.name: Sword Clenching

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not attempt sword clenching or pot balancing without proper training and safety oversight.

music_profile.sound_description: A striking percussive soundscape created by thirteen small metal cymbals (manjiras) tied directly to the dancers' bodies and struck in rhythmic patterns.

basic_steps: Assume seated posture on the ground.
Fasten thirteen manjira cymbals to specified body positions.
Balance ornamental pot on head and cover head with hat or petha.
Optionally clench small sword between teeth.
Strike manjira cymbals tied to the body in rhythmic unison while maintaining balance.
teaching.formation: Seated group of two or three women on the ground.
teaching.level_notes: Requires intense upper-body rhythm, physical balance for head-pot retention, and jaw stability for sword holding.
teaching.rhythm: Percussive rhythm produced by striking thirteen body-mounted manjira cymbals; specific meter not described in sources.
